programme.desc: Documentary about the moment that would change the future of football. In 2004, with the internet still in its infancy, it only belatedly dawned on Argentina that 16-year-old Lionel Messi, who had broken through at FC Barcelona, ​​was on his way to obtaining Spanish nationality. A VHS tape of Messi's highlights was made and delivered to the Argentina association to make him an Argentina international. – Documentary about the moment that would change the future of football. programme.title: ESPN DOC. Guess who's back!
programme.desc: After five long years, ADO Den Haag returns to the Eredivisie. In the summer of 2025, no one in The Hague saw this coming. No sponsor. No technical director. No trainer. Four weeks before the start of the season, the new trainer finally appeared: Robin Peter. A relatively unknown German, with a clear idea. Fresh. Offensive. Daring. With the help of Peter, the team grew into the best team in the Kitchen Champion Division. – After five long years, ADO Den Haag returns to the Eredivisie. programme.title: ESPN Highlights. Ron Jans' last dance

programme.desc: E5. Documentary about the FC Barcelona women's football team that broke free from an obscure existence and grew to become the top of the world. programme.title: I was a king - Lucjan Brychczy
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Lucjan Brychczy to prawdziwa legenda warszawskiej Legii. Był człowiekiem mocno doświadczonym przez życie. Dla skrzywdzonego przez wojnę dziecka, piłka nożna była sposobem na przetrwanie w trudnych czasach. Ze stołecznym klubem był związany od 1954 roku aż do swojej śmierci w 2024 roku. Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.title: Hero from the Shadow – Bruk-Bet Termalica Nieciecza | E02
programme.desc: Seria przybliża sylwetki osób pracujących za kulisami polskich klubów piłkarskich. Wykonują one bardzo ważne, niezbędne dla funkcjonowania drużyny obowiązki, które często są niewidoczne dla ludzi z zewnątrz. Od 20 lat Krzysztof Kozik pełni funkcję kierownika pierwszego zespołu Bruk-Bet Termaliki Nieciecza. He has been a resident of Nieciecza since birth. W latach 80. reaktywował klub piłkarski LZS Nieciecza, który w sezonie 2025/26 jest beniaminkiem Ekstraklasy. Kozik, known as Kiero, was also an active player and scored 245 goals for the team in the lower leagues. Poland. documentary series

programme.title: Vltava: the golden river
programme.desc: A documentary about the Vltava, the longest Czech river, whose source is in Šumava. It flows through the moorlands of this region and takes on a distinctive dark yellow color that makes it resemble liquid gold. The river was an inspiration for poets, architects and composers. The Vltava flows rather calmly, but from time to time it reveals its wild character and bursts its banks, and in places creates a cascade of reservoirs and dams. It also provides a home for many wild animals, such as spotted ground squirrels, shuttle tits, lynxes and wolves... Germany. 2020. documentary film

programme.title: Predators
programme.desc: An insightful look at the arms race in the animal world. Thanks to the use of special photographic techniques, the program makers present the world from the perspective of both the predator and the prey. Lions, cheetahs, panthers and other carnivorous animals have to work hard to get food. You must first locate the victim and, before capturing it, use trickery and win the race with it. After all, when a predator catches its desired target, it must make sure that its competitor does not take its prey away... documentary series

programme.title: Underwater City – Winter | S01E04
programme.desc: The Great Barrier Reef ecosystem is a unique and biologically diverse area, one of the largest structures of this type in the world. Like a bustling city, the reef harbors many distinct neighborhoods inhabited by coral and other animals, including lagoons, sandy islands and coastal rainforests. Each of these places has a unique rhythm of life, depending on the tides and times of day, as well as the variability of the seasons... Australia. 2024. nature series

programme.title: Secrets of water lands – Rivers | S01E03
programme.desc: The authors invite viewers on underwater journeys through oceans, swamps and other water areas from various parts of the world. In each episode, they show the richness of the ecosystems they visit, presenting the complex relationships between the organisms inhabiting them. Viewers will learn about the ecosystems that have developed in waterways in various parts of the world - from volcanic rivers in eastern Russia to geothermal streams in Florida. Filmmakers observe, among others: the activity of beavers, which gives a unique character to river landscapes, as well as the winter spa of manatees. Great Britain. 2025. nature series

programme.title: Wild Cuba: A trip to the Caribbean | E01
programme.desc: Colin Stafford Johnson takes viewers back to a time just 50 years ago when Earth's wildlife seemed abundant. It is a journey into a world that may soon disappear forever. The expedition begins in the south of the island in the Zapata Swamp. The largest single protected area in the entire Caribbean is home to the world's smallest bird, the bee hummingbird. Decades of a conservation-minded socialist government, US embargoes and minimal development have left the region largely unchanged for five decades. Regardless of politics, Cuba's isolation has created a natural citadel in the Caribbean. Forests cover large areas of the island, and its waters contain some of the richest coral reefs in the world. Half of Cuba's flora and fauna are found only here - from the local species of crocodiles and snakes to the smallest birds and frogs on the planet. Colin Stafford Johnson begins his expedition in the swamps of the Zapata Peninsula. Cuba's isolation means that there are places that have remained unchanged for decades, and the coral reef is one of the richest in the world. Austria. 2020. documentary film

programme.title: Africa: hot life – Caracals and bushfire | E05
programme.desc: Almost all wild inhabitants of hot regions of the world, such as Africa, are at risk of extinction due to climate change. The authors wonder whether and to what extent they will be able to adapt to new, difficult living conditions. Caracals live in terrain where the ground and vegetation are the same color; they are quiet and can disappear from sight: they are true masters of camouflage, as well as specialists in life in the desert and savannah. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: The Wild East of Poland
programme.desc: The documentary focuses on one of the last wild regions in Europe, the Biebrza Valley. The largest National Park in Poland is a habitat for beavers, otters and a whole host of water birds... Germany, Poland. 2023. documentary film

programme.title: Animals: Perfect Machines 2 – Camouflage Specialists | E04
programme.desc: A story about the evolution of animals over time. The creators of the series wonder how people can be inspired by the various features and abilities of wild creatures... Canada. 2025. documentary series

programme.title: Deadly Weather 2 | S02E05
programme.desc: Stories of people who encountered and recorded the most dangerous weather phenomena. Each episode presents blood-curdling footage from witnesses who survived fires, floods, tsunamis, hurricanes, avalanches, snowstorms and maritime disasters. There will also be reports from rescue operations. A compilation of recordings of dramatic events caused by the forces of nature. They hit South Africa with redoubled force. At the same time, a storm and disastrous fires came. It was too much for the emergency services. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.title: African predators: the big four – Lycaons | E04
programme.desc: The lives of the four largest predators living in Africa will be presented. The creators will look at their hunting methods, competition in herds, as well as strategies that ensure their survival in sometimes difficult conditions... Spain, Great Britain. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Pacific – Sea Depths | S01E04
programme.desc: The creators of the program talk about the Pacific Ocean, the largest ocean in the world, covering an area of ​​170 million square kilometers. Viewers will have the opportunity to look at the coral reef and see the local beaches and capes. They will also learn about the inhabitants of water, from crabs and sea cows to the more predatory rulers of the ocean. The creators of the program take viewers to the dark depths of the Pacific to show them the inhabitants of the ocean. The animals inhabiting these waters are often armed with dangerous fangs and large eyes. They often struggle with pressure, underwater volcanoes and darkness. Canada. 2020. documentary series

programme.title: Secrets of water lands – Lakes | S01E04
programme.desc: The authors invite viewers on underwater journeys through oceans, swamps and other water areas from various parts of the world. In each episode, they show the richness of the ecosystems they visit, presenting the complex relationships between the organisms inhabiting them. Full of mystical depth, lakes are spaces where life is constantly transforming. Their area is home to unique species of turtles, such as the aggressive snapping turtle. Viewers will see, among others: the metamorphosis of a dragonfly and the fight of flamingos with the water element. Great Britain. 2025. nature series

programme.desc: «90 years of LaLiga (2019): Abel Resino» Abel Resino holds the unbeaten record in the history of LaLiga. As an Atlético de Madrid player, he entered the Guinness Book by keeping a clean sheet for 1,275 minutes, which goes from November 25, 1990, in which Claudio scored a goal against him in Mallorca-Atlético and March 17, 1991, on matchday 26, when Luis Enrique managed to beat him in the 45th minute of Atlético-Sporting de Gijón played in Vicente Calderon. A total of 14 consecutive games without conceding a goal in the 1990/1991 season. A mark that is still valid in professional football and that helped him win the Zamora trophy with 17 goals conceded in 33 games. Champion of the Copa del Rey, in 1995 he decided to sign for Rayo Vallecano of Madrid to play his last active season. Abel played a total of 264 games in the highest category of Spanish football

programme.title: 30 for 30: The Two Escobars
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: Zambia Untamed: The Outcasts (S1E1). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2018. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2018 г. Год: 2018. Страна: JAV. Год: 2018. S1, Ep1 «Zambia Untamed»…In the Luangwa Valley lies a grove of Ebony trees, home to a troop of baboons. But, there are dangers here – the resident leopard who, unlike the other predators, is powerful and agile enough to climb trees. He's not an easy foe to eludeIn a magical corner of Zambia lies an extraordinary valley – a place where Africa's most charismatic animals live shoulder to shoulder. This series tells enchanting stories about the characters who call this place home, from the struggles of a baby elephant to a baboon born an outsider. From the smallest, to the tallest, a cast of engaging and intriguing animals brings this untamed African wonderland to lifeDirector: Beth Brooks

programme.title: Zambia Untamed: Living on the Edge (S1E2). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2018. S1, Ep2
programme.desc: 2018 г. Год: 2018. Страна: JAV. Год: 2018. S1, Ep2 «Zambia Untamed»…The plains and woodlands of the Luangwa Valley are the wildest and most merciless of all neighbourhoods where duels between predator and prey are played out both day and night. For the animals that call this home, it's a daily battle to stay aliveIn a magical corner of Zambia lies an extraordinary valley – a place where Africa's most charismatic animals live shoulder to shoulder. This series tells enchanting stories about the characters who call this place home, from the struggles of a baby elephant to a baboon born an outsider. From the smallest, to the tallest, a cast of engaging and intriguing animals brings this untamed African wonderland to lifeDirector: Mitch Turnbull

programme.title: Animals Like Us: Lion Daycare (S1E5) (Animals Like Us). Documentary, genre. England, 2023. S1, Ep5
programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2023. S1, Ep5 «Bizim Gibi Davranan Hayvanlar»…Discover why it takes a village to raise lion cubs in Kenya and sniff out the mating strategy of fragrant lemurs in Madagascar. Cut a rug at a honeybee dance party, then listen up as a forked-tailed drongo tricks other birds out of their dinnerPeek inside the lives of penguins, giraffes, chimps, and other animals that behave a whole lot like humans. Touch down on all seven continents around the world to see why these wild creatures compete, co-operate, love, and grieve just like we doDirector: Stuart Strickson

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue: Walking With A Pangolin (S2E3). Documentary about nature. England, 2022. S2, Ep3
programme.desc: 2022 г. Год: 2022. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2022. S2, Ep3 «Malawi Wildlife Rescue»…Crush a busy day with the team as they release rehabbed pythons, teach a pangolin how to hunt, and round up a troop of vervet monkeys. Search for a missing bird of prey with Dr. Charlotte, while Dr. Amanda helps a bushpig savaged by poachers' dogsMalawi is a small African country that has made a big push to protect its wildlife. Leading the effort is American veterinarian Dr. Amanda Salb and her colleagues at the country's only animal rescue center, where injured and abandoned creatures are saved and rehabilitated. This six-part series follows the dedicated team as they care for a variety of patients, including vervet monkeys, bulbuls, baboons, hedgehogs, and many more, often working with limited resources and in dangerous conditions as they prepare the animals to return to the wildDirector: Andie ClareCast: Amanda Salb, Torie Curr Smith, Dr. Charlotte Bentley

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue: Tsiba's New Mum (S2E4). Documentary about nature. England, 2022. S2, Ep4
programme.desc: 2022 г. Год: 2022. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2022. S2, Ep4 «Malawi Wildlife Rescue»…Tackle an emergency when Dr. Amanda removes a sable antelope's tracking collar, and see the animal-care team help a flea-riddled baby vervet monkey find a new mom. Free two orphaned serval cats and follow 20 yellow baboons into their new enclosureMalawi is a small African country that has made a big push to protect its wildlife. Leading the effort is American veterinarian Dr. Amanda Salb and her colleagues at the country's only animal rescue center, where injured and abandoned creatures are saved and rehabilitated. This six-part series follows the dedicated team as they care for a variety of patients, including vervet monkeys, bulbuls, baboons, hedgehogs, and many more, often working with limited resources and in dangerous conditions as they prepare the animals to return to the wildDirector: Andie ClareCast: Amanda Salb, Torie Curr Smith, Charlotte Bentley

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests: Water Worlds (S1E3). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2023. S1, Ep3
programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2023. S1, Ep3 «Secrets of the Enchanted Forests»…Wade into wetlands, where trees and water meet to nurture new life. Dive into an underwater forest that protects young fur seals, visit a mangrove sanctuary where a curious band of aquatic misfits hides out, and meet some real-life swamp monstersTraverse the planet's richest and most diverse woodlands – from the tropics to the poles and everywhere in between – and learn how forests connect and nurture the lives of countless speciesDirector: Mark ThorpCast: Fenella Fudge

programme.title: Brazil Untamed: Rheas-Cerrado (S1E8). Documentary about nature. USA, 2015. S1, Ep8
programme.desc: 2015 г. Год: 2015. Страна: JAV. Год: 2015. S1, Ep8 «Brazil Untamed»…Every year in the dry season, as the floodwaters disappear, the grasslands of the Pantanal are home to many species: giant anteaters, maned wolves and the greater rheas- the largest bird in South AmericaThe mesmerising wildlife of Brazil is revealed in this fascinating documentary series. Focussing on the Pantanal, the world's largest tropical wetlands, a team of scientists and camera crew study the remarkable creatures that inhabit the area. Predominantly located in the state of Mato Grosso do Sul, though also spreading into Mato Grosso, as well as Bolivia and Paraguay, this unique ecosystem is home to some of Brazil's most captivating species. The team work day and night to track these wonderful animals, including Capuchin monkeys, jaguars, giant otters, maned wolves, capybaras and a wealth of exotic birdsDirector: Emmanuelle Wiecha

programme.title: Wild Sky: Australia (S1E1). Documentary about nature. USA, 2025. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2025 г. Год: 2025. Страна: JAV. Год: 2025. S1, Ep1 «Wild Sky»…Scan the Australian skies, which regularly deliver some of the world's most volatile weather. Await cooling monsoon rains, watch lightning ignite vast wildfires, and marvel at the ingenious adaptations that help wildlife deal with these extremesWind, rain, drought and blizzards shape the lives of every living thing; we travel across North and South America, Africa and Australia to discover how animals find ways to survive Earth's wild skyDirector: Brennan NurthenCast: Kevin Spink

programme.title: d/s National Parks: Treasures of Life (Arrábida, Portugal)
d/s Journey of Chinese plants. 7 p.
programme.desc: Embark on an exciting botanical journey through China! In the documentary series, we will follow the amazing journey of Chinese plants, which have had a huge impact on the world's flora and culture. You will learn how tea, rice, bamboo and many other plants became symbols of China and spread throughout the world. China

programme.title: d/s Wildlife Diaries (Trout and Salmon)
programme.desc: In this episode, we delve into the world of trout and salmon, amazing reservoir fish found in both fresh and salt water. Dir.: Juan Antonio Rodriguez Llano, Álex Campos Casares. Spain

programme.title: d/s Symbols of wildlife (Birds of Africa)
programme.desc: For millions of years they led a humble existence, scurrying among the crevices and hills of the African landscape. These unassuming mammals work in tight-knit groups to survive and have proven to be quite intelligent and resourceful. France

programme.title: d/f Algeria from a bird's eye view. 1 p.
programme.desc: The eye of Arthus-Bertrand and his co-director Yazid Tizi allows us to discover this impressive country, endowed with exceptional cultural and natural riches. Dir.: Yann Arthus-Bertrand, Yazid Tizi. Ved.: Jalil Lesper. France, Algeria

programme.title: d/f Wild West: the life of a prairie dog
programme.desc: In the heart of the Great Plain, in Badlands National Park, prairie dogs are in a constant struggle for survival. The old dog is threatened by two young males who have decided to take his place. In this complex social structure, the struggle for territory and dominance intensifies. France

programme.title: d/f Winter birds
programme.desc: Every autumn, Finland becomes a starting point for hundreds of thousands of migratory birds such as cranes and geese. The long journey leads them to the Iberian Peninsula, located almost 4,000 kilometers from Finland. This epic flight is a true natural epic, full of dangers and challenges for birds seeking to find winter paradise. Spain

programme.title: d/s Great Barrier Reef: Living Treasure (Coral Coast)
programme.desc: The Great Barrier Reef is the only place in the world where ancient rainforests border a tropical reef, and the coastline supports a huge diversity of wildlife. Dir.: Richard Fitzpatrick, Richard Scotts. Australia

programme.title: d/f Deer - King of the Forest
programme.desc: The film shows the growth of the forest monarch from a fawn to an adult male. He faces seasonal challenges as he searches for food, fights for territory, overcomes danger, and cares for his young, demonstrating the real-life stages of surviving and growing up in the wild.

programme.title: d/s Predatory instincts. 1 p.
programme.desc: The project immerses the viewer in the cruel but amazing world of wild nature, where every day is a struggle for life. Kill or be killed - these are the only rules of the game that animals obey. But how do they cope with these harsh conditions? How has evolution taught them to adapt and survive in a world full of dangers? Canada

programme.title: d/s Predatory instincts. 2 s.
d/s Force of Nature (Song of Ice and Fire)
programme.desc: The change of seasons is a test for those who feel cold and heat more acutely. Animals live in the rhythm of the Earth, following the sun. For cubs, winter alone is painful, and spring without relatives is lonely. Fortunately, they have friends, partners and parents. China

programme.title: d/f Morocco from a bird's eye view. 1 p.
programme.desc: A unique journey awaits you over Morocco, where every frame is a new discovery. Flying over the Atlas Mountains, you'll see snow-capped peaks before being transported into the heart of the Sahara Desert, where sand dunes give way to green oases. The cameras will show ancient cities, lively markets and ancient fortresses hidden from the eyes of ordinary tourists. Get to know the culture, traditions and nature of this amazing country without leaving your home. Dir.: Yann Arthus-Bertrand. France

programme.title: d/s On the brink of extinction (Australia)
programme.desc: Every day, about 200 species of plants and animals leave the planet, accelerating the process of the sixth mass extinction. It is important to act to preserve biodiversity by protecting the natural centers of life that are located in different parts of the world. This project shows how life on Earth depends on the preservation of these ecosystems. United Kingdom

programme.title: d/f Odyssey of the European Bison
d/f Island Paradise – New Caledonia
d/s Predatory instincts. 3 s.
d/s Predatory instincts. 4 s.
d/s Clean Water Gardens (Europe)
d/s Strange Creatures of the Oceans (Sea Meadows)
d/f Small but insidious
programme.desc: The world of predators is cruel, especially for the little ones. Their fast metabolism requires constant hunting, and they know no fear. Tiny hunters attack prey that is larger than them, and in the struggle for survival they do not even hesitate to hunt each other. Spain

programme.title: d/f New Caledonia. Treasures of the planet
d/f Savage Land (Spanish Imperial Eagle)
d/f Wild land (Iberian goat)
programme.desc: The mysterious lands of southern Europe reveal a world where nature retains its original strength and diversity. In these harsh and picturesque landscapes, a variety of inhabitants coexist: the cautious lynx, the majestic imperial eagle, the mighty bear, the swift kingfisher, the mountain goat and the cautious wolf. Spain

programme.title: d/s Pack attacks in the wild (Hit or Flight)
programme.desc: It examines how animals in Africa, North America and Oceania overcome vast distances and various obstacles during migration. Dir.: Anja Taylor. Australia

programme.title: d/s Clean Water Gardens (Africa)
programme.desc: Water is a force of nature that shapes the behavior of animals and opens up new facets of survival and harmony on all continents of the Earth. In Antarctica, this element is concentrated in glaciers, in Latin America it fills rivers and jungles, in Africa it ensures the existence of savannas, and in Asia it becomes a decisive factor in conditions of natural contrasts. Spain

programme.title: Blue Wonder Pacific
programme.desc:
At 166 million square kilometers, the Pacific Ocean is larger than all of our planet's land areas combined. And it encompasses habitats that could hardly be more contrasting: the fantastic gardens of tropical coral reefs, the endless water desert of the open sea, the dense kelp forests off the coast of America. 

In two parts, “Terra X” portrays inhabitants of these worlds – the blue whale, for example. The probably largest animal that has ever lived in the world feeds on tiny creatures: it scoops up to forty million small crustaceans out of the water every day with its baleen. The sea otters off Big Sur are also food specialists. They specialize in sea urchins and prevent the spiny creatures from eating the seabed bare. 

Meanwhile, a heartbreaking drama is unfolding on the beaches of Costa Rica: When the olive ridley sea turtles hatch in September, hungry birds of prey and dogs are already waiting...

The cheekiest inhabitants are probably rhesus monkeys, which dominate entire neighborhoods in Jaipur.

programme.title: Our forests

programme.desc: Until now, the peninsula has been known more for political division or high-tech status. The 2-part documentary shows that the former “death zone” and the south of the peninsula now also contain hidden natural wonders, old traditions and biodiversity.

programme.title: The great parks in Africa
programme.desc: Table Mountain National Park is located on a rugged peninsula on the Atlantic Ocean. Surrounded by the sea and the metropolis, it impresses with its extraordinary biodiversity on the southwestern tip of Africa. (Station info).

programme.title: The great parks in Africa
programme.desc: iSimangaliso Wetland Park: Beaches, coral reefs, forests and lakes meet on the northeast coast of South Africa - a natural wonder that the locals call "The Miracle". (Station info).

programme.title: Portugal – wild and untamed
programme.desc: Hobby ornithologists get their money's worth along the beaches of the Algarve: Portugal's most famous coast is home to countless birds - from ducks to titmice to falcons. (Station info).

programme.title: Hidden Treasures of the USA
programme.desc: A river that cuts through swamps and prairies and inspired author Mark Twain: the Mississippi. The state of the same name reflects America's extensive history. (Station info).

programme.title: Hidden Treasures of the USA
programme.desc: From snow-capped peaks to white dunes. New Mexico is full of contrasts. Canyons hide ghost towns and abandoned mines - testaments to the state's history and culture. (Station info).

programme.title: Blue Wonder Pacific
programme.desc:
At 166 million square kilometers, the Pacific Ocean is larger than all of our planet's land areas combined. And it encompasses habitats that could hardly be more contrasting: the fantastic gardens of tropical coral reefs, the endless water desert of the open sea, the dense kelp forests off the coast of America. 

In two parts, “Terra X” portrays inhabitants of these worlds – the blue whale, for example. The probably largest animal that has ever lived in the world feeds on tiny creatures: it scoops up to forty million small crustaceans out of the water every day with its baleen. The sea otters off Big Sur are also food specialists. They specialize in sea urchins and prevent the spiny creatures from eating the seabed bare. 

Meanwhile, a heartbreaking drama is unfolding on the beaches of Costa Rica: When the olive ridley sea turtles hatch in September, hungry birds of prey and dogs are already waiting...

programme.title: Attack and defense
programme.desc: In the ocean, predators meet prey: sharks use their senses, while schools of fish use their swarm intelligence. A look at the evolutionary strategies in the fight for survival. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: Margery and her partner Betong eat 40 kilos of food a day. Since Margery has been eating twice as much lately, the zookeepers suspect what could be wrong with the female Malayan tapir. (Station info).

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: TRUY TÌM BÍ DANH SỐ 0 - THE COMEBACK
programme.desc: Chú Hứa là một đặc vụ đã nghỉ hưu, chủ một cửa hàng đồ cổ trên phố cổ. Một ngày nọ, khi con phố cũ bị Green Dragon Gang địa phương buộc phải phá bỏ, danh tính ẩn giấu của chú Hua vô tình bị tiết lộ và ông bị truy đuổi bởi một tổ chức bí ẩn do Ah Jie đứng đầu. Một cuộc đấu tay đôi chí mạng vừa mới bắt đầu!

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!

programme.title: ĐẶC VỤ TỬ THẦN - AGENT OF DEATH
programme.desc: Sau khi trải qua một thí nghiệm bí mật của chính phủ, đặc vụ Tara của CIA có được khả năng biến hình thành bất kỳ ai thông qua quá trình biến đổi DNA, khiến cô trở thành kẻ xâm nhập tối thượng. Khi cha cô bị sát hại và bằng chứng chỉ ra cơ quan của chính cô, cô buộc phải trở thành kẻ lừa đảo. Bây giờ, cô phải ngăn chặn uranium bị đánh cắp gây ra thảm họa hạt nhân toàn cầu.
